sources.title: Apertus AI
sources.snippet: Apertus 1.5 is a continued pretraining of Apertus 1.0: we added 4 trillion tokens of text and multimodal training data to the 8B model and 2 trillion tokens to the 70B model. As with every Apertus release, the models are fully open: open weights, open data, open values, and full training details.

sources.title: Apertus v1.5 8B - access through LLMTR
sources.snippet: Apertus v1.5 8B is an open-weight model that handles text and image input together. Its 262,144-token context window lets it work through long documents in a single request, and it can read images and describe their contents.
